description: The durable postimages describe the state that must exist after their exact reviewed and accepted package is successfully applied. Candidate authoring, review, acceptance, and apply receipts remain external and non-recursive.

required_literals: These postimages project the canonical state after independent review, exact-byte
The Work Pack remains `block` and its execution entry remains `blocked`
Work Pack Readiness / Implementation Readiness validation
fresh independent review, exact-byte owner acceptance, material handoff, and
canonical apply are closed for the installed package
Work Pack Readiness, Implementation Readiness, and a separately accepted

forbidden_literals_in_recomposed_tree: repaired acceptance-bound postimages have not received renewed independent review
owner has not accepted these exact bytes and canonical targets are not applied
repaired Plan package remains blocked on renewed independent review

regression_phases.pre_review: Build and scan the complete recomposed 20-target tree against this projected state before independent review.
regression_phases.pre_apply: Bind fresh review and owner acceptance to the candidate postimage digest; separately bind the material package and receipt to their material digest; prove the material package embeds this exact candidate inventory and 20 postimages; bind the ready handoff to the exact material receipt; rehash live baselines and rerun the projected-state scan before mutation.
regression_phases.post_apply: Rehash all canonical targets against the apply receipt and rerun the same projected-state scan over live canonical bytes before readiness routing.

reopen_rules: Any changed postimage byte creates a new package digest and reopens independent review and exact-byte owner acceptance.
Any changed live baseline blocks apply and requires a fresh candidate inventory.
Any missing or mismatched lifecycle receipt blocks pre-apply validation.
Any post-apply lifecycle contradiction stops readiness routing and requires exact rollback when the transaction contract permits it.
claim_ceiling: Projected planning lifecycle consistency only. No readiness, Task Session, P4, R4, L2, provider, release, publication, deployment, or production claim.
